Definition: from G773; an Asian (i.e. Asiatic) or an inhabitant of Asia:--of Asia.
BiblicalUsage: Only one verse uses this word, naming Tychicus and Trophimus as Asians travelling with Paul toward Jerusalem. They were part of the company carrying the gift for the believers there.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the gospel made travelling companions out of strangers, and Asia's sons walked beside Paul as brothers.
